programme.title: Ibsen
programme.desc: The 1992 adaption of Henrik Ibsen's classic play, directed by David Thacker. Nora, tired of being patronised and casually discounted by her husband, rebels against him and by doing so discovers a whole new personality within herself.

programme.title: Ibsen
programme.sub-title: All the World's a Stage: The Master Builders
programme.desc: From 1984, Ronald Harwood looks at the founders of modern drama: Henrik Ibsen, August Strindberg, George Bernard Shaw and Frank Wedekind.

programme.title: Sound Waves: The Symphony of Physics
programme.desc: Dr Helen Czerski examines the extraordinary messages sound wave carry, and how they help us understand the world around us. Visiting a hidden location buried beneath the hills of Scotland, Helen experiences some of the most extreme acoustics in the world. She discovers how sound has driven the evolution of incredible biological systems and complex relationships between creatures that exploit sound for hunting.

programme.title: A Wild Year
programme.desc: In the far south west corner of Wales lies Pembrokeshire's wild and rugged coast. Twisting and turning along the edge of the Atlantic, life on this ancient coastline is defined by the rhythm of the seasons and the power of the sea. Fishing these fertile waters has long been a tradition here. Every day, local fisherman Jono Voyce heads out from Solva harbour into St Brides Bay to fish for the lobster and crab he supplies to these coastal communities.

programme.title: Wild China
programme.desc: The extreme landscapes north of the Great Wall have shaped some of China's most colourful people and wildlife. From nomadic tribes hunting with eagles, to camel trains crossing the Silk Road, from frozen Siberian wastes to baking deserts of Central Asia, life in northern China is always on the edge.

programme.title: Call My Bluff
programme.desc: Robert Robinson hosts the panel game of word definitions and deceptions. Team captains Frank Muir and Patrick Campbell are joined by guests Jilly Cooper, Lesley-Anne Down, Quentin Bell and Anthony Valentine.

programme.title: Face the Music
programme.desc: Joseph Cooper invites viewers to test their musical wits against Valerie Pitts, Robin Ray and John Julius Norwich. With guest musician Stephen Kovacevich.

programme.title: Do We Really Need the Moon?
programme.desc: Space scientist and lunar fanatic Dr Maggie Aderin-Pocock explores our intimate relationship with the Moon. The Moon is such a familiar presence in the sky that most of us take it for granted. What if it wasn't where it is now? How would that affect life on Earth? Besides orchestrating the tides, the moon dictates the length of a day, the rhythm of the seasons and the very stability of our planet.

programme.title: Cosmonauts: How Russia Won the Space Race
programme.desc: This remarkable feature-length documentary combines rare and unseen archive footage with interviews with the surviving cosmonauts to tell the fascinating and at times terrifying story of how the Russians led us into the space age.

programme.title: Horizon
programme.desc: First transmitted in 1998, this is the story of four men who orbited Earth on board the ill-fated Mir space station, which NASA declared unsafe in 1991. Although Mir had been lived in almost continuously since she was launched in 1986, the joint Russian-American mission in 1997 saw unprecedented problems on board the station; from fire, power blackouts and mechanical breakdowns to a dramatic midspace collision that left everyone on board scrambling for their lives.

programme.title: How to Build a Dinosaur
programme.desc: Dinosaurs died out 65 million years ago and we have hardly ever found a complete skeleton. So how do we turn a pile of broken bones into a dinosaur exhibit? Dr Alice Roberts finds out how the experts put skeletons back together, with muscles, accurate postures, and even - in some cases - the correct skin colour.

programme.title: Roy Clarke Remembers... Open All Hours
programme.desc: The recently knighted sitcom writer Roy Clarke looks back on one of his best-loved creations, Open All Hours, and shares his memories of working with two comedy legends.

programme.title: Open All Hours
programme.desc: Arkwright takes action when his corner shop is broken into and employs a large dog to guard his property. Unfortunately, the unruly creature is more successful at keeping customers at bay than frightening any burglars who may be about.

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Hyacinth's father has sustained an injury chasing the milkwoman on his bicycle and is now heavily sedated in hospital.

programme.title: London: A Tale of Two Cities with Dan Cruickshank
programme.desc: Dan Cruikshank follows the footsteps of John Stow and John Strype, two of London's greatest chroniclers, to explore one of the most dramatic centuries in the history of London. The 17th century saw London plunged into a series of devastating disasters. The Civil War, a murderous plague and the destruction that was the great fire should have seen the small medieval City all but destroyed.

programme.title: The Secret Science of Sewage
programme.desc: Dr George McGavin and Dr Zoe Laughlin set up base camp at one of the UK's biggest sewage works to investigate the revolutionary science finding vital renewable resources and undiscovered life in human waste. Teaming up with world-class scientists, they search for biological entities in sewage with potentially lifesaving medical properties, find out how pee can generate electricity, how gas from poo can fuel a car and how nutrients in waste can help solve the soil crisis.

programme.title: Easter Island Origins
programme.desc: New theories about how the stone heads of Easter Island, also known as Rapa Nui, were carved and raised. New research challenges previous ideas about the history, innovation and resilience of the Rapanui people.

programme.title: Coastal Path
programme.desc: Paul Rose explores the soft and rolling South Devon coastline where he takes a snorkelling trip around Burgh Island and hitches a ride on the Dartmouth to Paignton steam train.

programme.title: Brian Cox's Adventures in Space and Time
programme.desc: Brian takes a fresh look at the concept of gravity, revealing it to be far more than just the force that makes things fall to the ground. Recent scientific breakthroughs are challenging physicists' ideas of the very nature of reality. He recalls some of his most iconic TV moments: being first on the scene to meet a space capsule returning three astronauts from the International Space Station, and demonstrating how a bowling ball and feather fall at the same speed.

programme.title: Tribe
programme.desc: Documentary series with explorer Bruce Parry. He sails to the island of Anuta, a tiny, remote tropical outpost in the South Pacific. It is one of the most isolated communities on Earth. To the Western eye it looks like paradise - white beaches, turquoise sea, swaying palm trees - but is there such a thing as paradise on Earth?

programme.title: Michael Palin Remembers... East of Ipswich
programme.desc: Michael Palin recounts the story behind his much-loved drama `East of Ipswich', the semi-autobiographical tale that captures how he and Helen, his wife of 57 years, first met whilst still teenagers on their summer holidays in the 1950s.

programme.title: Number 27
programme.desc: A young property developer tries to convince a 90-year-old woman to sell her house.

programme.title: Castles: Britain's Fortified History
programme.desc: Sam Willis traces the history of the British castle, from its first appearance with the Normans in 1066 to the longest siege on English soil at Kenilworth Castle 200-years-later.

Teleshopping
programme.desc: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

programme.title: Channel Off Air
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Olobobs
programme.desc: Ar ôl diwrnod o gerdded yn y glaw mae Tib, Lalw a Bobl yn dychwelyd adre i Goeden glyd, ac mae ymwelwyr ganddynt. The Leafs follow the Olobobs home on a rainy day but start making a mess!

programme.title: Sam Tân
programme.desc: Gem ffon yw Hela Pryfed Estron. Mae Norman, Mandy, Sara a Jams yn mwynhau chwarae, efo cystadleuaeth daer rhyngddyn nhw a Siarlys a Meic Flood. The gang play the Alien Bug Hunt phone game.

programme.title: Jen A Jim Pob Dim
programme.desc: Jen and Jim would like to go for a ride on their bikes, somewhere close to home, but how will they know which places are far and which are near?

programme.title: Chwedlau Tinga Tinga
programme.sub-title: Pam Does Gan Neidr Ddim Coesau?
programme.desc: Once Snake had hundreds and hundreds of legs, but no eyes. Then one day, Snake bumped into Millipede, who was stuck in a hole. They decided to swap eyes and legs just for one day, but when Snake came back to return Millipede's eyes, Millipede couldn't be found anywhere.

programme.title: Byd Tad-cu
programme.desc: Pam bod pengwiniaid ddim yn gallu hedfan? Dyma cwestiwn Ela i Tad-cu heddiw. 'Why can't Penguins fly?' is the question Ela asks Tad-cu today.

programme.title: Cywion Bach
programme.desc: Trwyn mawr, trwyn bach, trwyn hir. Ie, Trwyn yw gair arbennig y Cywion Bach heddiw. Big nose, small nose, long nose. Yes, Trwyn (Nose) is the special word today.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Pan ma mam yn gas efo powlen gymysgu, mae Pablo a'r anifeiliaid yn mynd i mewn i'r cwpwrdd i wneud y bowlen deimlo'n well. Pablo and friends go into the cupboard to cheer up a mixing bowl after Mum was rough with it.

programme.title: Misho
programme.desc: Cyfres yn edrych ar sefyllfaoedd all godi pryder i blant bach; cyfle i dawelu meddyliau drwy ganu, sgwrsio a chwerthin! A look at situations that can cause worry to small children.

programme.title: Guto Gwningen
programme.desc: Mae gan Nel Gynffonwen dant poenus, mae Guto'n mynd ar ei sled drwy'r eira i nôl Dr Gynffon Gwta. Nel has a painful tooth, Guto takes his sled through the snow to fetch Dr Gynffon Gwta.

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae Signor Silvo, ffrind Syr Gwil, yn dod ar wyliau i'r parc, ac yn coginio'r pitsa perffaith. Signor Silvo, Syr Gwil's friend, comes on holiday to the park, and cooks the perfect pizza.

programme.title: Anifeiliaid Bach y Byd
programme.desc: Anifeiliaid anwes yw'r thema y tro hwn a down i nabod y gath, y mochyn cwta a'r bochdew. The theme this time is pets and we get to know about cats, guinea pigs and hamsters.

programme.title: Stiw
programme.desc: Mae garej Taid yn llawn trugareddau, a daw hen gôt law yn ddefnyddiol iawn i drwsio barcud Stiw. An old waterproof jacket in Taid's garage proves to be ideal material to fix Stiw's kite.

programme.title: Caru Canu a Stori
programme.desc: Mae'n ben-blwydd ar Lleu Llygoden, ac mae'n edrych ymlaen at dderbyn parsel arbennig iawn. It's Lleu Llygoden's birthday, and he's looking forward to receiving a special parcel.

programme.title: Sion Y Chef
programme.desc: Siôn helps Magi out on the farm by enlisting Jac Jôs' errant drone to deal with a troublesome crow.

programme.title: Ne-wff-ion
programme.desc: Newyddion i blant hyd at 6 oed a fydd yn diddannu ac yn eu dysgu am y byd o'u cwmpas nhw yn ei holl amrywiaeth. Entertaining and educational news for children up to 6 years old.

programme.title: Og y Draenog Hapus
programme.desc: Mae Og yn teimlo'n unig pan mae ei ffrindiau i gyd yn rhy brysur i chwarae ag e. Og feels lonely when all his friends are too busy to play with him.

programme.title: Twm Twrch
programme.desc: Hoff fwyd Twm Twrch yw mwydod, ond heddiw mae Dorti yn ei herio i fod fel hi a pheidio â bwyta mwydod. Today, Dorti challenges Twm Twrch to be like her and to not eat worms at all.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach Ni
programme.desc: Heddiw bydd yr antur yn mynd â ni i wlad Sweden, i ddysgu mwy am dirwedd Sweden, bwyd traddodiadol fel peli cig ac ymweld â Stockholm, sef y brifddinas. A trip to Sweden.

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Diolch i dechnoleg estron, mae Joni'n dysgu bod angen mwy na doniau'n unig ar archarwr. Thanks to alien technology, Joni learns that a superhero needs more than just talent.

programme.title: Cacamwnci
programme.desc: Cyfres gomedi i blant meithrin sy'n cynnwys sgetsys, eitemau doniol, jôcs a chymeriadau dwl iawn. A comedy show for pre-school children, full of sketches, jokes, fun, monkey nonsense and great new comedy characters.

programme.title: Olobobs
programme.desc: Mae'r Olobobs wedi mynd am dro yn y goedwig ac yn dod o hyd i Ffosibob coll. Sut gall yr Olobobs ei helpu i ffeindio'i ffordd adre? The Olobobs are enjoying a nice walk in the forest when they bump into a poor little Fozzybob who seems to be a bit lost. Can Eye-Spy help Fozzybob find her way home? Only if he can actually find her!

programme.title: Sam Tân
programme.desc: A fireman named Sam always saves the day in the fictional Welsh rural village of Pontypandy. Alongside his fellow firefighters, he deals with all types of emergencies, from everyday problems to big disasters.

programme.title: Jen A Jim Pob Dim
programme.desc: The farm is quiet today: someone must be missing! Can the `llyfr pob dim' help Jen and Jim find the missing animal?

programme.title: Chwedlau Tinga Tinga
programme.sub-title: Pam Fod Meerkat Wastad Yn Cadw Golwg Ar Bawb?
programme.desc: There was a time when Meerkat was not always on the lookout. Meerkat used to race around Tinga Tinga bumping into things and causing chaos. She never stayed still long enough to listen to any beast.

programme.title: Byd Tad-cu
programme.desc: Pam bod mwncïod yn byw mewn coed'? yw cwestiwn Jamal i Tad-cu heddiw. Jamal asks why monkeys live in trees. Tad-cu has an absurd story, full o fun about two cheeky monkeys named Jess and Caleb.

programme.title: Cywion Bach
programme.desc: Mae gair gwych heddiw. Dere i ddysgu ac arwyddo'r gair Siwmper gyda Bip Bip, Pi Po, Bop a Bw! What a great word today. Come to learn and sign the word Siwmper (Jumper).

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Nid yw Pablo'n hoffi camera newydd nain. Mae'n rhaid i Draff esbonio i'r camera sut i beidio dallu pawb cyn fod Pablo yn hapus i gael tynnu ei lun. Pablo doesn't like grandma's camera. Draff has to explain to the camera how not to blind everyone.

programme.title: Misho
programme.desc: Teimlad o bryder sydd dan sylw heddiw, ac mae Mr Diarth yn ei gwneud hi'n anodd i blentyn bach aros yn nhy Mamgu. Mr Diarth makes it difficult for a small child to stay over at Grandmas.

programme.title: Guto Gwningen
programme.desc: Mae Guto Gwningen a'i ffrindiau'n trio darganfod beth yw dyfais newydd tad Benja, Mr Sponcen. Guto Gwningen and his friends try to find out what Benja's dad's invention is used for.

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae Signor Silvo, ffrind Syr Gwil, yn dod ar wyliau i'r parc, ac yn coginio'r pitsa perffaith. Signor Silvo, Syr Gwil's friend, comes on holiday to the park, and cooks the perfect pizza.

programme.title: Newyddion S4C a'r Tywydd
